title: F5Bot
description: Set up public-community keyword alerts without storing your alert terms, email address, or account state in the public walkthrough.

steps.title: Open F5Bot
steps.body: Open F5Bot and sign in or create an account. Your email address and login details remain between you and F5Bot.
steps.humanGate: Email verification, login, CAPTCHA and terms stay under your control.

steps.title: Find the login or alert control
steps.body: Use Find on page. If you are logged out, CTRL should find a login/sign-up control. If you are already logged in, it may instead find the alert-creation surface.

steps.title: Create a narrow alert
steps.body: Choose a specific keyword or phrase that matters to your research. The public walkthrough never contains your private research terms; enter them directly in F5Bot.

steps.title: Use alerts as leads
steps.body: Treat incoming community mentions as research leads, not verified evidence. Check important claims against stronger sources before relying on them.
